test_fix_vectorized_models: test the BeanMachine compiler fix_vectorized_models transformation using BMGInference to_dot on probabilistic models
test_BMGInference_to_dot_before_transfor: test BMGInference to_dot method with after_transform=False to view the model graph before devectorization rewrite
test_BMGInference_to_dot_after_transform: test BMGInference to_dot method with after_transform=True to view the devectorized model graph
test_bm_random_variable_decorator: test the bm.random_variable decorator for defining vectorized Bernoulli, Beta, Normal, and StudentT random variables
test_bm_functional_decorator: test the bm.functional decorator for defining deterministic transformations like multiplication and complement_with_log1p
